description: This is a Python source file defining configuration management for a backend API, specifically loading settings from environment variables related to JWT authentication, JSON seed data, ingestion directories, and external service URLs. It includes a Settings dataclass, utility functions for parsing environment variables, and a factory function get_settings to instantiate configuration settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable data class that stores application configuration settings loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: timedelta access_token_expires(self)
methods.description: Calculates and returns the expiration timedelta for access tokens based on the configured minutes.

methods.name: bool str_to_bool(value: str | None)
methods.description: Converts a string input to a boolean value, interpreting common truthy representations.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Settings instance populated with environment variables and default values.
